cohort: The study analyzed monthly C-section rates among women giving birth in Kurdistan province, Iran, from March 2018 to January 2023.
finding: The C-section rate did not show a significant change immediately after the onset of COVID-19, but the monthly trend increased significantly during the post-pandemic period.
mod_finding: The monthly trend of C-section rates increased significantly during the post-pandemic period, but no significant change was observed in C-section rates among primigravid women after the onset of COVID-19.
